Maya (Growth): Quick check — we pushed the search seed expansion and new headline set to the campaign. Seeing early pacing issues. Anyone on adops?

Ross (AdOps): On it. Which ad group? Share the dashboard link?

Maya (Growth): search-core-us / retarget-14d. Dashboard: https://app.redwood-inference.com/ads/dashboards/abc123. Topline: spend pace ~30% above expected; CPC +12%. Suspect audience overlap + creative mismatch.

Ross (AdOps): I'll split audiences: 50% -> seed-only, 50% -> seed+retarget for next 24h. Pausing headline H3 (the long one).

Jules (Marketing): Can we swap H3 for "Ship LLM features faster — pay less"? Also add CTA variants: "Try free demo" vs "Book demo". Shorter copy tends to win.

Sam (Data): Added a pacing cap at campaign level (-10% daily) to slow burn. Created quick report: impressions by keyword × creative. Link: https://analytics.redwood/quick/xyz. Will flag CPA changes.

AdOpsBot: Campaign search-core-us updated: creative H3 paused, audience split created (50/50), pacing cap applied.

Ross (AdOps): Nice. We'll monitor for 6h then revert split if CPA spikes. @Maya can you push a quick UTM for the H3 replacement? Need source=paid & campaign=search-seed-2026_v1

Maya (Growth): Done — UTM params pushed and internal doc updated ( /docs/campaigns/search-seed-2026 ). Thanks team :thumbsup:
